faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Carolina Dog?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 30-65 lb (14-29 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a puppy Carolina Dog?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Dental disease; Parasite exposure if free-roaming history; Allergies. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 1-2 weeks on the same scale while a Carolina Dog is growing, with the number saved beside vaccine dates.
